programs.title: Cloud Forest Stewardship: Worker-Led Ecology Monitoring
outcomes: Explain how the Ecology DAO's agent-managed, human-governed model applies to environmental work safety and land stewardship
Interpret evidence summaries produced in the Research Synthesis Lab
Draft a workplace or community ecology proposal for the Proposal Forum
Identify which decisions stay human-reserved in the DAO charter

sessions.activity: Guided reading of the DAO charter and reserved-for-humans list; small-group mapping of how worker voice fits an agent-managed DAO.
Hands-on with an Evidence Monitor sample: learners evaluate a summarized biodiversity claim from Monteverde Cloud Forest Reserve and check it against sources.
Role-play a working-group task routing exercise: teams receive tasks from the Task Router simulation and assign roles, mirroring union task allocation.
Teams draft a short ecology proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter framework; proposals are debated but never enacted by the group, honoring human-only enactment.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized proposal drafts and task-routing decisions (no names, no employer identifiers) contributed as training examples for the DAO's proposal and coordination shared models.
programs.consent: Participation is voluntary with written informed consent; learners may opt out of data sharing at any time and have their contributions removed on request, per the union education agreement.

programs.title: Canopy Citizens: Kids Governing a Cloud Forest DAO
outcomes: Describe why Monteverde's cloud forest is a biodiversity hotspot
Explain the difference between agent work and human-only decisions in a DAO
Practice evidence-based discussion and voting on a class proposal

sessions.activity: Story-based tour of the Ecology DAO charter: students draw the DAO's zones and mark which five decisions only humans can make.
Students act as junior Evidence Monitors: read a simplified species-summary card about Monteverde cloud-forest birds and flag what is fact vs. guess.
Class builds a wall chart of measurable outcomes; students track their own learning progress the way the Progress Tracker agent tracks the charter.
Class debate and secret-ballot vote on one simple conservation proposal drafted with the Proposal & Grant Drafter template; teacher enacts the result.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized class-level results only (aggregate quiz scores and vote tallies, no individual names or IDs) to help improve shared educational models.
programs.consent: Signed guardian/parent consent is required before participation; guardians receive a plain-language data notice and may withdraw their child's data at any time; no individual student data is collected.

programs.title: NGO Observer Program: Partnering with an Agent-Managed Ecology DAO
outcomes: Map NGO programs onto the DAO's zones and agent roles
Assess how agents can support, but never replace, human governance in joint conservation work
Design a collaboration proposal respecting the reserved-for-humans list

sessions.activity: Workshop comparing the NGO's own governance to the DAO charter; participants identify which decisions in a joint project must remain with human boards and voters.
Staff practice briefing stewards: turn a Research Synthesis Agent output on tropical biodiversity into a one-page decision brief for their leadership.
Simulation with the Collaborator Scout role: identify skill sets needed for a Monteverde-linked working group and draft a task-routing plan.
Teams co-draft a grant proposal using the Proposal & Grant Drafter structure; peer review focuses on clarity of human decision points.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized briefing templates and proposal drafts (organization names and staff identifiers removed) contributed to shared models that improve agent drafting quality.
programs.consent: Organizational memorandum of understanding plus individual staff consent; a data-sharing annex specifies anonymization, purpose limits, and the right to withdraw organizational data.

programs.title: Steward Readiness: Nonprofit Leaders in the Ecology DAO
outcomes: Explain the 'agents operate; people govern' principle to boards and donors
Evaluate measurable outcome frameworks for an ecology charter
Prepare stewardship practices that keep final votes, treasury and amendments human-controlled

sessions.activity: Executive seminar on the charter and the six human-reserved actions; leaders draft a board policy stating which decisions will never be delegated to agents.
Leaders review sample Progress Tracker dashboards and workshop how to set honest, measurable biodiversity outcomes without inventing statistics.
Mock decision cycle: agents present drafted proposals; nonprofit leaders debate and hold a formal human vote, practicing final_vote responsibility.
Capstone: leaders design a working-group structure for a cloud-forest education initiative, defining what agents route and what humans approve.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized governance templates and vote-outcome patterns (no organizational or personal identifiers) shared to strengthen the DAO's steward-training models.
programs.consent: Institutional consent at registration and individual consent for any contributed materials; anonymization is verified before sharing, and contributors can request deletion at any time.
